control_mean.restriction: Absolute-profile metrics require a training-derived assay-compatible control centroid; zero-delta comparisons remain distinct.

perturbed_mean.restriction: Requires a training-derived perturbed centroid on the same frozen gene and response scale as the evaluated output.

ridge_perturbation.restriction: Requires one target feature interface that is computable for every held noncoding or intervention target without nearest-gene substitution or target outcomes.

bilinear_perturbation.restriction: Requires held-capable context and target vectors plus a prospectively affordable exact Kronecker design.

systema.restriction: For the registered single-component target task its prediction equals perturbed_mean and is one fitted-model family, not an additional independent win.

gse281160.species_and_assay: human HepG2 single-cell RNA with CRISPRi guide assignment
gse281160.topology: same_cell guide and RNA; six sequencing lanes are technical; experimental replicate is the biological unit
gse281160.target_design: 20 MPRA-selected noncoding target loci with top two guides; conditional follow-up, not an unbiased target sample

eligible_after_activation.control_mean: yes if a frozen control-guide definition and experimental-replicate pseudobulk exist
eligible_after_activation.perturbed_mean: yes after target-locus and guide-family holdout
eligible_after_activation.ridge_perturbation: conditional on an outcome-independent sequence or target feature manifest for every held noncoding locus
eligible_after_activation.bilinear_perturbation: conditional on the same held-capable target features and a context vector defined without target outcomes
eligible_after_activation.systema: yes as the independently implemented matching mean; identical to perturbed_mean for this single-component task

blocking: Freeze biological replicate identities and counts; cells, guides, and six sequencing lanes are not replicates.
Freeze the custom GRCh38 plus sgRNA-pseudogene reference, base gene annotation, guide-to-target crosswalk, and feature IDs.
Freeze control guides, target-level pseudobulk, QC denominators, gene scale, and target feature interface before fitting.

gse275483.species_and_assay: mouse pooled mosaic liver perturbation single-cell RNA plus unpaired imaging
gse275483.topology: same-study unpaired modalities; animal is the biological unit
gse275483.replication: n=4 animals, three ad-libitum and one fasting
gse275483.eligibility: Conditional descriptive stress use only after mouse reference, target and guide identities, RNA-to-animal joins, controls, and a training-only ortholog/output crosswalk are frozen. All five baselines are otherwise not runnable.
gse275483.prohibition: Approximately 103000 hepatocytes cannot be used as independent replication, and the one fasting animal does not estimate a fasting population effect.

gse313774.species_and_assay: human liver-chip bulk RNA and intervention identities
gse313774.topology: 33 libraries nested in n=3 independent experimental batches; libraries are not cells or biological replicates

eligible_now.control_mean: Only a precommitted zero-change delta is structurally valid without reading chip outcomes. An absolute control centroid cannot be fitted from withheld chip expression.
eligible_now.systema: not currently component matched and no chip outcome may construct the strict reference

activation_conditions: Freeze the 33 library-to-batch and Condition 1 or Condition 2, with or without insulin, assignments.
Freeze the deposited gene identity and a project-reference crosswalk.
If a cross-assay delta or gene-program output is proposed, freeze its gene universe, transform, intervention mapping, and missingness before opening outcomes.
Commit predictions before outcomes are joined; never use CXCL1 or IL8 as confirmation endpoints.
No deposited resmetirom RNA arm exists.

split_and_fit_firewall.outer_split: Group cohort_family_id, target_locus, guide_family, and biological_replicate before any fitting.
split_and_fit_firewall.inner_split: Ridge and bilinear selection repeats target-locus, guide-family, and biological-unit grouping inside outer training.
train_only_state: Systema component matches and strict reference
calibration if a future probabilistic endpoint is registered
split_and_fit_firewall.held_features: A held target's outcome-independent sequence or design features may be transformed by a frozen mapper. Held expression, guide response, DE ranking, and pathways cannot fit or repair that mapper.
split_and_fit_firewall.gse313774: Design can be visible, but all 33 expression profiles remain evaluator-only until the prediction commit. No target-scale mapping may be invented after outcome opening.

Systema_interpretation.matching_mean: A published predictive baseline. It falls back to the training perturbed mean for unseen perturbation components and is exactly that baseline for the current single-component task.
Systema_interpretation.strict_reference: Subtract the same outer-training perturbed centroid from predicted and observed profiles. This changes the origin and emphasizes deviations from a population perturbation mean.
Systema_interpretation.transductive_variant: A reference estimated from evaluation outcomes is an evaluator-only transductive diagnostic. It is never returned to models and cannot alter selection or claims.
Systema_interpretation.language: Call this linear re-referencing or centering. Do not call it deconfounding, leakage correction, residual causal effect, or a separate learned model.

assay_native_and_missingness_crosswalk.single_cell: Sum raw gene counts to target-locus by experimental-replicate pseudobulk before normalization. Preserve cell and guide counts only as QC denominators.
assay_native_and_missingness_crosswalk.bulk_chip: Keep each library's bulk count scale and batch design. Do not feed libraries into single-cell adapters or convert 33 libraries to n=33.
assay_native_and_missingness_crosswalk.mouse: Keep mouse gene IDs and expression units until a frozen one-to-one ortholog output is created; ambiguous or absent orthologs are explicit missing states.
assay_native_and_missingness_crosswalk.rule: A missing control, target feature, gene, ortholog, guide join, or profile never becomes zero response.

uncertainty_and_claims.resampling: Use 10000 paired cluster bootstrap replicates at experimental replicate, independent liver-chip batch, or animal level. Preserve every target and gene row nested within a sampled unit.
uncertainty_and_claims.multiplicity: BH q<0.05 inside the exploratory perturbation-transfer endpoint family; cells, guides, targets, genes, libraries, and seeds are not independent tests or replicates.
uncertainty_and_claims.selection: A deep model must beat control_mean, perturbed_mean, ridge_perturbation, and bilinear_perturbation on an applicable assay-native comparison. Systema does not double-count perturbed_mean for single-component targets.
uncertainty_and_claims.champion: No sealed perturbation source exists, so no model in this track can earn an open MASLD champion claim.
uncertainty_and_claims.clinical: No treatment-response, diagnostic, prognostic, or clinical validation claim.

reproducibility_contract.required_receipt: For each fold and model, hash biological-unit pseudobulk rows, controls, gene scale, context and target features, masks, weights, centroids, split groups, inner folds, selected regularization, coefficients, Systema matches and reference, predictions, and evaluator input.
reproducibility_contract.unit_of_inference: experimental replicate, independent experimental batch, or animal
